summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including all appendices and references, and checked every estimate against the cited pages of the 49-page August 2026 PDF using PyMuPDF. All 26 regression coefficients, standard errors, printed significance bounds, the approximate coherent-logic standardized effect, and recorded participant counts match the correct outcomes and table columns. The GPT coefficients contrast GPT with Control in the factorial models; interaction coefficients are not direct combined-arm contrasts. Complete-sample arm counts are supported, while arm counts remain appropriately null for analyses affected by the two missing within-solution diversity scores. The recorded model sample sizes are distinguished from the unprinted totals for the two named arms. Outcome coding, scale direction, measurement units, AI availability, timing, comparison type and within-person status are supported. Participant-level observations and the documented clustering within randomized classes support the recorded se_basis and the warning against pooling these standard errors as class-level precision. No omitted eligible outcome or directly reported arm contrast was found under extraction rules 4-6. No verification problems identified.
